content: The current emission state is a pause; episode 42 ended 14.8 days ago [E5]. At Pahala, the last 24 usable hours show a maximum of 26.3 ppb and a latest reading of 0.2 ppb at 16:00 HST [E1], while the upwind Volcanoes NP station reports a maximum of 0.0 ppb over the last 6 hours [E3]. Forecast transport indicates 1 of 3 leads have the 925 hPa wind blowing toward Pahala with a mean component of 3.3 m/s [E6], and the 850 hPa wind also carries a southerly component toward the area. Stability is characterized by a boundary layer that will collapse to 127 m by 06:00 HST [E6] under an inversion base at 2193 m [E7], which limits vertical mixing.
